readme: ShaderLab backgrounds for Portfolio carousel cards: a library, imported per card by id, not one per project. `file` is the art-layer image, `preset` is the ShaderLab recipe it was rendered from, `shadowColor` is the image's average colour for projects.ts. Regenerated on every Export all. See ~/Projects/ShaderLab/handoff/README.md.
